subject.title: fix(agents): xAI/Grok requests fail after a stale reasoning replay ("could not decrypt encrypted_content")

question: For this xAI/Grok code-less encrypted_content decrypt error, should maintainers accept pre-fix production logs plus the mocked positive/negative retry tests as sufficient proof, given the contributor says the exact provider-side trigger cannot be induced on demand?
rationale: ClawSweeper's external-PR gate normally requires after-fix real behavior proof, but the reported trigger depends on xAI snapshot/key rotation and may not be reproducible until it recurs organically.

options.title: Accept source-level proof with maintainer override
options.body: Treat the pre-fix logs, dependency contract, current-main predicate gap, and narrow regression tests as sufficient for this provider-owned trigger and proceed with normal merge review.

options.title: Hold for organic after-fix proof
options.body: Keep the PR open until a future xAI rotation produces redacted gateway logs showing the stripped retry succeeds on the real service.

options.title: Replace with broader recovery work
options.body: Defer this PR in favor of a larger provider-error or drain-level retry design such as the overlapping work in https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/95587.

recommendation.title: Accept source-level proof with maintainer override
recommendation.body: Treat the pre-fix logs, dependency contract, current-main predicate gap, and narrow regression tests as sufficient for this provider-owned trigger and proceed with normal merge review.

likelyOwner.reason: This person authored the current same-predicate encrypted reasoning recovery path, so they are the best history-backed owner for a proof-sufficiency call on extending that path.
